The document contains no solid-modeling, topology-validity, data-exchange, re-import, bounding-box or volume-check content, so it cannot support the model. The only tangentially related geometric statement is the convex-hull containment property of B-spline curves (page 40), which is a curve property, not a kernel verification policy.

The code and registry use 0.027 Re^0.8 Pr^(1/3) (mu_b/mu_w)^0.14 (the classical Sieder & Tate 1936 form, which is not held in the corpus). Same structure and viscosity correction; different coefficient and Prandtl exponent. Relative to the SP-125 RP-1 form the code's h_c is higher by about 26% at Pr = 1, 17% at Pr = 3 and 7% at Pr = 11.7 (RP-1 at 600 R).
